spellbook.finance/limitations: The workspace owner can inspect the connected account. An unknown allowance admits no new ends.
Stale refreshes require single-card Auto-list. Variation parents, watched/sold listings, open offers, reserved stock, and protected trial items are excluded.
Queued work is not a confirmed replacement. Inspect run.restored and run.error before claiming recovery.

description: Read an owner's eBay month-end policy, estimated remaining insertions, reserve, usable capacity, Pacific execution window, and current recovery counts. Remaining already includes reserved active renewals and the existing margin. It returns facts, missingFields, and limitations; it does not establish eBay's exact billing balance or a sales benefit from refreshing.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the caller owns. Required.
